name: Sainik School Scholarship Located Outside the Uttarakhand
benefit:
**Rate of Scholarships:**

- ₹40,000/- per annum for students from families with a monthly income up to ₹12,000/-.
- ₹30,000/- per annum for students from families with a monthly income of ₹12,001/- to ₹15,000/-.
- ₹20,000/- per annum for students from families with a monthly income of ₹15,001/- to ₹18,000/-.
- ₹10,000/- per annum for students from families with a monthly income of ₹18,001/- to ₹2
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be studying in Classes 6 to 12 in a Sainik School located outside Uttarakhand. - The scholarship will be awarded on the basis of the applicant’s family income. - The applicant is not eligible if the monthly family income exceeds ₹22,000/-.
